contract_plain_english: For a fixed parameter p strictly between 0 and 1, a Bernoulli random variable Xi equals 1 with probability p and 0 with probability 1 − p. Its mean is p and its variance is p(1 − p). In this passage the Xi occur in an inherited i.i.d. central-limit-theorem setting, but independence is a property of the sequence context, not part of what Xi ∼ Ber(p) means.
